name: on a Thursday, 'persembe' is today or next week: the bot asks, never silently picks next week
incident: Live failure of 2026-11-19 05:01 (ADR 0012): the owner wrote 'persembe ogleden sonra 4e' on a Thursday meaning today; the bot proposed Perşembe 26 Kasım (next week) and the owner confirmed without noticing. A bare weekday that is today now asks 'today or next week?' and every preview shows weekday and full date.

steps.say: camasiri ama bitirdim ona gerek yok persembe gunu sadece alexa ve hue kurulumlarini yapalim bunu ekle persembe ogleden sonra 4e
